phase_note: Fase 1 (00–07): fondasi → metrik → UI → WhatsApp → Odoo → agen v1 → Orchestrator → MCP. Fase 2 (08–14): peta relasi, agen v2, memori & kalibrasi, pengaturan, eksekusi nyata, hardening, pilot.

stages.name: Fondasi: monorepo, Postgres, migrasi, seed, Makefile, CI
stages.summary: Monorepo Go (cmd/arc api·worker·ctl, chi, pgx, goose, river, sqlc) + web Vite/React 19 dengan token & CSS mockup; migrasi 0001 (semua tabel 03-data-model + commitments) & 0002 river; seed 18 dealer dari mockup via tools/seedgen (idempoten); /api/health, /api/me (X-Dev-User), heartbeat river; make dev/check/migrate/seed/sqlc; CI.
stages.notes: Tanpa Docker: Postgres 17 native + DATABASE_URL_TEST skema per test (ADR 0006). Proyek di subfolder distri-arc-kit/ (kode ARC v1 di repo induk belum dihapus — butuh keputusan Sam).

stages.name: Domain & metrics engine (rumus Orbit) + API baca dealer
stages.summary: internal/domain + internal/metrics (siklus order median, status, aktivitas, segmen, SOW, product mix, sisa limit, pola bayar, tepat waktu, PIC aktif, skor 5 komponen, KPI, push kandidat, rekomendasi order); 16 kasus glossary + uji properti; seed regression: 18 dealer = mockup (toleransi 0); job metrics.recompute (10 mnt) & metrics.snapshot (00.30 WIB); API baca dealers/orbit/segmen/due/drift/credit-tight/kpi/agenda/stock/credit; arc ctl metrics.
stages.notes: KPI dihitung dari rumus: order tepat jadwal 81% (mockup 85%), DSO 30 hr kredit-saja (mockup 36), perputaran stok 46 hr, lewat tempo Rp 141 jt. Skor dihitung tanpa FMA agar pembulatan x,5 sama dengan rumus acuan.

stages.name: Frontend shell + Pusat kendali (baca) + Orbit/Segmen/Dealer
stages.summary: Shell React persis mockup (rail, topbar + view tabs, ⌘K, tabbar, dock, toast, sheet; CSS mockup verbatim); Pusat kendali (baca: hero, Orchestrator card, ringkasan template /brief/today, jadwal order, lewat jadwal, KPI utama, agenda sales, push stok, limit tipis), Orbit (SVG + anti-tabrak), Segmen (log-Y, zona, titik 3 bulan lalu), Dealer (semua bagian); SSE /api/events; vitest 11 + Playwright 13 (6 rute × 1440/390, tanpa scroll horizontal).
stages.notes: Rencana hari ini, Keputusan, dan tombol aksi menampilkan empty state "menunggu Orchestrator (Stage 06)". Layar Orchestrator/Chat/Peta relasi/Push stok/Kredit/Pengaturan/Panduan berupa placeholder sampai tahapnya. Screenshot di web/e2e/__screenshots__.

stages.name: WhatsApp ingest (whatsmeow + Cloud API), nomor internal, grup, Chat
stages.summary: internal/wa: Transport (fake, whatsmeow QR multi-device + riwayat, Cloud API webhook+Graph) dan ingest idempoten dengan filter privasi (DM internal dibuang, grup internal tanpa dampak ke dealer, nomor baru → thread baru); worker: ingest streaming, wa.pair, outbox.send (batas harian, jeda acak, balasan manusia); API Chat + nomor internal + grup + status/pair; Chat 3 panel & Pengaturan persis mockup; arc ctl wa inject.
stages.notes: Tanpa nomor uji: transport fake. whatsmeow belum diuji dengan ponsel nyata; enkripsi sesi WA_SESSION_KEY belum (ADR 0007). Riwayat WA sintetis hanya sebagai sinyal.
